title: Impact Evaluation for Education and Public Policy
department: Teaching and Learning, Policy and Leadership
description:
Prerequisite: Knowledge of multivariate regression and prior experience with statistical programming software (e.g., Stata). TLPL765 or permission from instructor.
Credit only granted for: TLPL766, TLPL672, or EDPS621.
Formerly: TLPL672. Students will learn about and practice using a variety of quantitative research methods that allow for causal inferences and can be applied to estimate the impact of policies or programs in education and other policy sectors.
